heading: Today
text: Any morning snow south of Rt. 4 and Laconia, NH tapering off. Cloudy, with a hint of sun in Quebec, and late in the day south. Highs in the 30s to near 40 over the higher terrain, 40 to 45 in the valleys. Winds north less than 10 mph, except 10 to 15 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Cloudy, and a bit colder. A few snow showers after midnight from Quebec south to the Adirondacks and Rt. 2. Lows in the 20s. Winds north less than 10 mph, except 10 to 15 mph through the Champlain Valley, diminishing overnight.

heading: Saturday
text: Mostly cloudy. A glimpse of sun in southern valleys. A chance of morning snow or rain showers from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north, likely in the afternoon. Highs in the 30s to near 40 north, 40 to 45 in the Champlain Valley and south. Winds light, becoming northwest up to 10 mph.
